messages:
incident-bot: [pager] SEV2 - billing/metering: token-count drift observed on prod-emitter us-east-1 (alert BM-91234). spike started ~03:21 UTC, +15% token delta.
alice_oncall: I'm on it. paging @bob_sre and @carla_billing. will coordinate.
bob_sre: looking now. quick glance at emitter logs shows repeated ACKs for same emit_id beginning 03:21. possible duplicate path / replay.
carla_billing: seeing customer-facing overage flags and automated emails for ~120 customers. pulling list & rate of flags.
dan_infra: checking Kafka consumer groups and emitter relay health across us-east cluster.
bob_sre: here's a quick log excerpt:```
emitter: emit_id=abc123 status=ACK
emitter: emit_id=abc123 status=ACK
emitter: emit_id=abc123 status=ACK
```
emma_support: getting inbound tickets from customers about unexpected charges. drafting temporary message. any mitigation ETA?
alice_oncall: options: 1) throttle emitter to single-write path 2) route to fallback meter 3) pause billing notification emails. fastest is fflag to dedupe path. thoughts?
bob_sre: agree. will set feature-flag to enable server-side dedupe and throttle duplicate ack handling. command: `ffctl set emitter_dedupe true --env=prod`
dan_infra: rolling fflag to 30% of nodes now, will expand if metrics look good.
incident-bot: fflag change recorded by deploy-bot at 03:27 UTC (change-id ff-2026-618999).
carla_billing: pausing automatic billing notification pipeline to avoid more customer emails. queueing notifications for manual review.
emma_support: sending interim customer message: "We're aware of incorrect billing flags for some customers and are pausing billing notifications while we investigate. No action required from you."
alice_oncall: preliminary impact estimate: ~1.2M extra tokens between 03:20-03:45 UTC. potential overcharge window. tagging billing ops for manual credits.
frank_ops: collect list of affected accounts + delta_tokens ASAP. we need CSV for credits. @carla_billing can you produce?
carla_billing: generating CSV now, will upload to /shared/billing/incident-6189990123.csv when done. sample row: `acct_123, 4500, $0.09`
bob_sre: monitoring graphs now — after fflag at 03:28 token emission normalized and duplicate ack rate dropped to baseline. continuing sweep for any remaining replays.
alice_oncall: next steps: 1) finish CSV + issue credits (carla) 2) run dedupe backfill job bkf-2026-03-17 (bob) 3) postmortem + action items (alice). ETA backfill ~2 hours.
emma_support: holding support tickets open; escalating any customers requesting immediate refunds.
incident-bot: incident state -> monitoring at 04:00 UTC. please file postmortem in #postmortems and link runbook.
carla_billing: CSV uploaded: /shared/billing/incident-6189990123.csv (columns: account_id,delta_tokens,est_credit_usd). sample preview attached in the file share.
alice_oncall: thanks everyone. actions: add automated dedupe to emitter pipeline, add alert to detect duplicate-ack patterns, document mitigation steps. assigning owners: carla (credits), bob (backfill + code fix), dan (deploy automation). :thumbsup:
frank_ops: noted. postmortem due in 72h. assigning `postmortem-6189990123` to oncall rotation.
carla_billing: uploading final credits batch and notifying finance for audit.
bob_sre: backfill job started (job-id bkf-2026-03-17). monitoring progress, will update when complete.
alice_oncall: closing this thread, moving to incident tracker. great response, minimal customer escalations.
